workload.description: Order a long collection of extension types whose inheritance relationships require repositioning.

validation.details: Ran natively with Python 3.12 in an isolated pinned Cython checkout at sizes 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16; correctness assertions passed and marker_probe observed the target region. No extra packages were installed.

tests.coverage_note: Loads the pinned source file, asserts its resolved path, exercises ModuleNode.sort_types_by_inheritance with bounded input, and verifies entry into the empty region marker.
